article.title: U.S. Canada trade war intensifies
article.author: John Clarke
article.content: While Trump’s gangster imperialism exacerbates the trade war with Canada, workers must not simply rally to the side of their own national capitalists, argues John Clarke. The post U.S. Canada trade war intensifies appeared first on MR Online .
